name: French green lentils with lardons
steps: Fry the bacon lardons until crisp and golden.
Add the diced onion, carrot and celery and soften.
Stir in the cooked green lentils to coat in the fat.
Add a splash of chicken stock and a bay leaf, then simmer 10 minutes.
Season with black pepper and a dash of red wine vinegar.
Spoon into a bowl and serve warm.
